optimized_plan:
Sort: [nation Asc, o_year Desc]
  Project: [nation, o_year, sum_profit AS sum_profit]
    Aggregate: group_by=[nation, o_year], aggs=[SUM(amount)]
      SubqueryAlias: profit
        Project: [n_name AS nation, EXTRACT('YEAR', o_orderdate) AS o_year, ((l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) - (ps_supplycost * l_quantity)) AS amount]
          INNER Join
            on: ps_suppkey = l_suppkey AND ps_partkey = l_partkey
            Scan: partsupp [ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, ps_comment]
              projection: [0, 1, 3]
            INNER Join
              on: s_suppkey = l_suppkey
              INNER Join
                on: n_nationkey = s_nationkey
                Scan: nation [n_nationkey, n_name, n_regionkey, n_comment]
                  projection: [0, 1]
                Scan: supplier [s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_nationkey, s_phone, s_acctbal, s_comment]
                  projection: [0, 3]
              INNER Join
                on: o_orderkey = l_orderkey
                Scan: orders [o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus, o_totalprice, o_orderdate, o_orderpriority, o_clerk, o_shippriority, o_comment]
                  projection: [0, 4]
                INNER Join
                  on: p_partkey = l_partkey
                  Project: [part.p_partkey]
                    Scan: part [p_partkey, p_name, p_mfgr, p_brand, p_type, p_size, p_container, p_retailprice, p_comment]
                      projection: [0, 1]
                      filter: (p_name LIKE '%green%')
                  Scan: lineitem [l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment]
                    projection: [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]
physical_plan:
ExternalSort
  Project
    SpillableHashAggregate
      Project
        Project
          SpillableHashJoin
            MemoryTableScan
            SpillableHashJoin
              SpillableHashJoin
                MemoryTableScan
                MemoryTableScan
              SpillableHashJoin
                MemoryTableScan
                SpillableHashJoin
                  Project
                    Filter
                      MemoryTableScan
                  NativeStreamingScanExec
